conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, we’re getting locked out of Keelwater every time we try to log in — it keeps saying the system is down, but I’m pretty sure it’s not actually your side.

We keep getting error messages that say Keelwater is down, but I think it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our corporate VPN is interfering with the login flow.
Internal note: customer reported access issues; confirmed it's not a Keelwater outage but likely their sign-on provider or network configuration. Escalated to network liaison for follow-up.
Thanks for reaching out, Elwenna. I’ll check the status on our end right away — sometimes these ‘down’ messages come from your own sign-on service or network setup, not our product.
That makes sense — we’ve had issues before with our VPN and the SSO provider. I’ll try bypassing them and get back to you.
Appreciate you troubleshooting that, Elwenna. If it still fails, let me know — we can walk through the supplier integrations or check your roles and tasks permissions together.
Got it working! Must’ve been the VPN. Thanks for the quick help — you saved me from a whole afternoon of claims reporting delays.
Glad to hear it’s resolved! Let us know if you need help with documents, reserves, or supplier payments next time — we’re here to keep your policyholders’ claims moving smoothly.
